load_scales_into_module: load scale factors from a JSON or PT file into a PyTorch module's ScaleFactor submodules
load_scale_dict_from_file: load scale factors from a JSON file, PT file, or dictionary into a scale dictionary
apply_scaling_to_model: apply scaling values to all ScaleFactor modules found in a PyTorch neural network module
validate_scale_factors: validate that all ScaleFactor modules in a model have corresponding entries in the scale dictionary
load_json_scale_factors: load scale factors from a JSON file and strip the optional comment field before returning
